notes.title: Demo stage play video
notes.notes:
[p]This is not a progress report on game development, But I captured some video footage using the demo version currently under development for exhibition purposes. :)
[/p][previewyoutube="VICNGkbxsQs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We hope you enjoy the intense battles against attacking aliens and the fierce fighting of the unusually strong "sister unit-chan" (tentative name) in the video! [/p][p][b]The Last Salvage SQUAD[/b] is currently in production for release in 2025. Please add it to your wish list and stay tuned! [/p][p]At Waku Waku Games, We are committed to promoting domestically produced FPS games created by Japanese developers and creators. :)[/p]

notes.title: Be the first to experience games at Game Pavilion JP!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! 
On August 10, at the indie game exhibition[b] “Game Pavilion JP”[/b] held at Mydome Osaka, you will have the opportunity to be one of the first to play a trial version of “[b]The Last Salvage Squad[/b].” If you are an FPS fan or Indie-game fan living in the Osaka area, please come and visit us at the venue! Check out the latest development status of the game you are interested in at the video below![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="g-bREbbPNdY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]At the venue, We will be waiting for you with ‘The Last Salvage Squad’ postcards and acrylic stands as trial play bonuses! Both are limited in quantity, so if you absolutely want them, be sure to come to the Waku Waku Games booth right after the venue opens! 

For event details and ticket purchase information, please visit the official website: [/p][p][url="https://gamepavilion.jp/"]https://gamepavilion.jp/[/url]

Thanks![/p][p][/p]
